searchText: hi guys, what do you guys think we do a team sync up and ideation meeting? I think the next bi-weekly is 10/27, we can move it earlier? or you guys can arrange in person one if you all are in bogota. I was thinking to use figjam for whiteboarding, can talk about: - improvement and remaining features from current build - dashboard - records lastly, if time allows we can chat about the ending ceremony & poap. it will be good to do a short post mortem as well. <Marcin> Hey, so the double-signing spec assumes we hold contributor identities in the transcript. That means our existing transcript can't be made valid – we could just make it slightly less invalid by padding it with some placeholder identity. Question is: do we want to, or do we just drop it and start anew, assuming we're still very early? @CarlBeek <CarlBeek> i think we should start anew. there was some modulo bias in the entropy generation we just removed so i’m not super satisfied with the contributions thus far. i think we should migrate the sequencer to the monster machine, get a more secure deployment of the website and start afresh <Marcin> > <Marcin> ACK. I expect to have double-signing done early next week. (re @CarlBeek: i think we should start anew. there was some modulo bias in the entropy generation we just removed so i’m not super satisfied with the contributions thus far. i think we should migrate the sequencer to the monster machine, get a more secure deployment of the website and start afresh) <Recmo> > <Recmo> Which bias? AFAIK the frontend used /crypto since monday which shouldn’t have bias. (re @CarlBeek: i think we should start anew. there was some modulo bias in the entropy generation we just removed so i’m not super satisfied with the contributions thus far. i think we should migrate the sequencer to the monster machine, get a more secure deployment of the website and start afresh) <Recmo> But agree on restarting, this one is pure chaos with many duplicate contribution. <Recmo> We want entropy, not chaos. <nicoserranop> > <nicoserranop> I think Carl is referring to the entropy generation in the frontend. We recently implemented a HKDF expansion instead of using the ethers js random wallet generator with entropy as seed (re @Recmo: Which bias? AFAIK the frontend used /crypto since monday which shouldn’t have bias.) <Recmo> aah, ok. I was thinking of adding argon2 HKDF to /crypto. Is that still useful? <Marcin> /crypto good thought, i will add another call next week to make up for missing this week, and to catch everyone up from devcon
